zones.name: Rillmere Valley
zones.climate: Temperate river terraces; warm sunrise, overcast midday and light river mist. Rain is cosmetic until explicitly enabled in fishing rules.
zones.services: Hearthford hub at the river crossing: Mara merchant/quest giver, Tovin trainer, Ilyra bank clerk, Orun smith, Selka cook and Neris fishing contact. Shrine on the dry west bank.
zones.travel: Proposed 45–90 seconds between early objectives, 3–5 minutes hub-to-north-gate on foot and a 7–10 minute optional exploration circuit; time real capsule travel, not map distance alone.
zones.hazards: Shallow ford transitions into a clearly marked deep channel. A broken footbridge has safe banks and a visible return route. No climbing dependency.
zones.arc: First Steps teaches identity and interaction; Road Supplies repairs a warning post; The Sluice Signal reveals old waterworks being disturbed by survey crews.
zones.music: Acoustic strings and restrained low winds; water, woodwork and distant birds. Commission/original or licensed stems, never bundled here.
zones.art: Graybox landscape, ford/bridge, six small service buildings, ore/tree stand-ins, shoreline and water material. Needs separately sourced terrain, foliage, props, buildings and creature sprites.
zones.optimization: One modest graybox map initially; separate town/wilderness actor budgets. Add internal streaming only after measured memory and traversal tests. Zone gates connect separate processes.
tests: Enter every service from spawn without jumping or climbing.
Two players mine OreSite_01 after deterministic selection; one depletes its generation.
One client takes north gate; the other stays in Hearthford.
Fish from both sides of ford; reject cast from deep swimming water.

zones.name: Thornweald
zones.climate: Ancient closed-canopy woodland; dappled light, cool dusk and periodic rain. Maintain readable sprite outlines under canopy.
zones.services: Boughrest trail camp supplies a merchant, healer contact and return shrine. Wardens occupy a ruined boundary tower; no full bank until a later content milestone.
zones.travel: Proposed 4–6 minutes between trail camp and boundary tower, with shortcuts unlocked through exploration rather than mandatory vertical climbing.
zones.hazards: Roots and narrow bridges test stairs/steps and camera occlusion. Hollow trees are interiors, not fully simulated tree destruction.
zones.arc: The Wardens investigate hollow resonators that attract predators; the player chooses a recorded diplomatic response, not an irreversible main-story lock.
zones.music: Sparse bowed strings and branch creaks; distinguish hostile cues from ambient animal calls visually as well as acoustically.
zones.art: Canopy/occluder materials, layered ground cover, bridge meshes, tower kit and three creature sprite families. Phase06 uses only a safe gate courtyard and legal debug placeholders.
zones.optimization: Canopy/foliage culling and simple collision; navigation on authored trails; test relevancy across tree occlusion independently of rendering.
tests: Reciprocal Rillmere gate works with source player left behind.
Tall canopy fades locally without removing server collision.
Navmesh routes enemies across Sevenroot Bridge and leashes safely.
Missing creature animation uses debug presentation without changing hit capsule.

zones.name: Morrowfen
zones.climate: Misty wetland with low sun, periodic heavy rain and limited lightning flashes under accessibility settings.
zones.services: Reedgate stilt camp has fisher, cook, repair vendor and shrine. Raised boardwalk loop connects quest contacts without swimming.
zones.travel: Proposed 3–4 minute boardwalk loop and 5-minute camp-to-estuary route; swimming is an optional shortcut, not the only service access.
zones.hazards: Deep channels, slow-mud volumes with explicit tags and low-visibility fog. Mark shore exits and avoid hidden lethal water.
zones.arc: Flood gauges disagree with the tide. Craft repaired instruments, fish local species and trace diverted water to the coast.
zones.music: Low reeds, water insects and soft percussion; subtitled/visual hazard warnings.
zones.art: Stilt-house and boardwalk kit, water/shore masks, swamp vegetation, fog volumes and enemy sheets.
zones.optimization: Bound translucent overdraw, weather particle count and expensive water reflections. Collision/navmesh separates boardwalk heights from water.
tests: Fish cast intersects approved pool and shore line of sight.
Swim-to-boardwalk exit cannot clip underside.
Weather transition does not reroll an active fishing attempt.
Fog and large text preserve objective/telegraph readability.

zones.name: Kestrel Crown
zones.climate: Wind-cut highlands with clear long views, fast cloud shadows and occasional sleet.
zones.services: Crownwatch road fort provides bank extension, trainer, smith, merchant and safe travel hub unlocked by arrival.
zones.travel: Proposed 6-minute valley-to-fort road, 4-minute fort-to-hall approach. Long slopes require measured camera/facing comfort.
zones.hazards: Steep drop-offs with visible rails on primary roads; optional fall-damage routes; no forced mount or climbing.
zones.arc: Rebuild ridge beacons and decide which faction receives survey records. Either choice retains a route to mountain service access.
zones.music: Open restrained brass/strings with wind and stone ambience; no continuous loud gust masking combat cues.
zones.art: Cliff/rock kit, fort walls, switchback road, stair meshes, conifers and mountain water.
zones.optimization: Distant HLODs/foliage budgets after prototype; server AI only in bounded encounter regions. Test long-view relevancy separately.
tests: Capsule handles all road steps/slopes at 200ms RTT without repeated corrections.
Fall damage samples server-approved fall, not client Z claim.
Unlocked fast travel uses signed zone transfer and charges once.
Bridge/lower-road enemy navigation remains on correct level.

zones.name: Varran Halls
zones.climate: Mountain stronghold and cavern approaches; cool exterior light, warm workshops and low-lit ruins with readable silhouettes.
zones.services: Forgeward hall has smith, bank, trainer, faction contact, guild registrar and shrine. Maintain service access during schedule changes.
zones.travel: Proposed 2-minute service circuit, 5–7-minute hall-to-descent route, and 15–25-minute optional ruin outing.
zones.hazards: Forge hazard volumes, vertical stacked corridors and bridges. Decorative stairs must have simple collision and validated navigation.
zones.arc: Competing guilds seek to restart a pressure engine; expose its failing seals and choose a reversible service alliance.
trees: Rootwood: authored cavern roots, not arbitrary rock nodes
zones.music: Stone resonances and forge rhythm; layered ambience lowers during important dialogue.
zones.art: Modular hall/interior kit, pipes, forge props, emissive materials, cavern landscape and machinery. All are acquisition/authoring tasks.
zones.optimization: Interior streaming may separate wings within this zone only; preserve stable site/gate IDs across sublevels and check persistence unload hooks.
tests: Upper bridge and lower hall sprites occlude correctly; no global sort-priority hacks.
Unloaded interior nodes reload depleted according to backend state.
Ambient schedules never remove the only repair service.
Guild UI cannot mutate bank or economy facts.

zones.name: Brinewake Coast
zones.climate: Storm coast with clear breaks, sea fog, rain and authored tide visuals; initial tide does not dynamically reshape navmesh.
zones.services: Saltreach harbor supplies full services, coastal quest contacts, boat-gate waypoint and dungeon assembly point.
zones.travel: Proposed 4-minute harbor-to-ruin approach and 6-minute coast-road loop. Boat transitions are controlled loading gates, not an unbuilt sailing simulator.
zones.hazards: Surf/deep-water boundaries, sea-cliff drops and storm visibility; safe dry fishing platforms and respawn approaches.
zones.arc: Water resonators from each region converge at a ruined sea lock. Resolve the regional conflict through a cooperative encounter rather than an endless world simulation.
zones.music: Low sea percussion, waves and harbor work; optional reduced storm intensity.
zones.art: Coastal cliffs, harbor/boat props, seawall/ruin kit, ocean/shore materials and creatures. No ships are supplied by the character ZIP.
zones.optimization: Cap ocean/weather rendering, stage shoreline collision and cull distant decorative boats. Server fishing tests use approved volumes, not rendered wave height.
tests: Boat gate moves only the requesting party members with individual tickets.
Server restart during bite produces no catch unless receipt committed.
Rare weather fish rule is disabled until explicitly balanced and versioned.
Endgame dungeon return retains inventory, quest completion and safe hub.

hub.name: Hearthford
hub.layout: Spawn shrine west; central square services; bridge east to wilderness; bank and crafting court north; dry fishing pier south; north road to Thornweald. Keep required services within a proposed 90-second walking loop.

dungeon.name: Sluice Vault
dungeon.story: A damaged ancient water-regulation chamber is drawing wildlife and overloading its stone custodian.
rooms: Intake gallery: two enemy role groups and a safe staging ledge
Pressure chamber: channel telegraphs and the Sluice Custodian boss
phases: 100–60%: frontal cone and slow lane warning
60–25%: alternating water lanes and two bounded adds
25–0%: faster but nonoverlapping cone/lane sequence; tuning proposal
dungeon.reward: Personal eligible loot, one encounter reward namespace, no global first-kill grant
dungeon.recovery: Wipe resets encounter state and active adds; reward claims already committed remain claimed. Disconnected member can rejoin same active instance lease; expired instance returns safely.
